generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

1.The Bidder should be an empanelled agency in KPTCL for conducting Surveying and Geo-technical investigation works under below category. Class-I Eligible to participate in Surveying and Geo-technical investigation works for transmission lines of all voltage class Class-II Eligible to participate in Surveying and Geo-technical investigation works for 66KV and 110KV transmission lines only
2.The bidder should submit copy of the valid empanelment letter issued by the Corporate Office, KPTCL.

3.The bidder should have achieved in at least two financial years (out of last five years), a minimum financial turnover (in all types of Surveying/Geo-technical investigation/Consultancy works only) of Rs.22,52,052.00/-.(usually not less than two times the estimated value of contract) copies of financial turnover issued by the charted accounts are to be furnished

4.The bidder should have in the last five years satisfactorily completed atleast one Surveying and Geo-technical investigation work for an engineering project of value not less than Rs. 9,00,821.00/- (usually not less than 80% of the estimated value of contract). carried out in central Government/State government/Semi Government/Public Sector undertakings. Certificate issued by an officer not below rank of Executive Engineer is to be furnished.
